chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Rashid narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:

I said, 'May I be your ransom, do the Muslims have a festival other than the two Eids?' He said, 'Yes, O Hasan, and it is the greatest of them and the noblest of them.' He said: I said to him, 'So which day is it?' He said, 'It is a day on which Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام was appointed as a standard for the people.' I said, 'May I be your ransom, and which day is it?' He said, 'Indeed the days revolve, and it is the eighteenth day of Dhu al-Hijjah.'

He said: I said, 'May I be your ransom, and what should we do on it?' He said, 'You fast it, O Hasan, and increase in it the salat upon Muhammad and his Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, and declare disavowal before Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, from those who wronged them of their right. For indeed the Prophets عليهم السلام used to command the successors that the day on which the successor was established should be taken as an Eid.'

He said: I said, 'What belongs to one of us who fasts it?' He said, 'The fasting of sixty months. And do not abandon fasting the twenty-seventh day of Rajab, for it is the day on which prophethood was sent down upon Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and its reward is like sixty months for you.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: title of Imam Ali عليه السلام as the leader of the faithful
key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْ: invoking blessings upon Muhammad and his family عليهم السلام
key_terms.النُّبُوَّةُ: prophethood bestowed upon Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.تَبَرَّأُ: to declare disavowal before Allah from the wrongdoers
key_terms.ذِي الْحِجَّةِ: the month of Dhu al-Hijjah in which this appointed day occurs
key_terms.عِيدٌ: a festal day of religious significance

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the Eid of Ghadir and the reward of fasting on it?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies the eighteenth of Dhu al-Hijjah as a great Eid for the Muslims, the day on which Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام was appointed for the people. It encourages fasting, abundant salat upon Muhammad and his Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, and disavowal from those who wronged them. It also mentions the merit of fasting on the twenty-seventh of Rajab, the day of the descent of prophethood upon Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.
